library.name: std
library.description: The standard fragments shipped with RAICHU, written in the library format itself: the generic ones (time profiles, measures, thresholds, republished values, state exports, negations), and forwarding names for the fragments that moved to the `muscadet` library, withdrawn at the next major release. Its version is the engine's: a standard fragment changes with the engine, and the expanded model records the engine version that supplied it.

fragments.name: bool_flow_in
fragments.description: Forwards to `muscadet.bool_flow_in`, which this name applies unchanged; withdrawn at the next major release. A boolean input flow `<name>`: an in port `<name>_in` and the attribute `<name>_fed_in`, true while the connected sources feed it under `logic`.

parameters.name: logic
parameters.description: How the connected sources combine: all of them (and), any of them (or), or at least k of them (k). An input nothing feeds reads its default under every logic.

parameters.name: k
parameters.description: The k of a k-out-of-n input.

parameters.name: default
parameters.description: What the input reads while no connection feeds it.

fragments.name: bool_flow_out
fragments.description: Forwards to `muscadet.bool_flow_out`, which this name applies unchanged; withdrawn at the next major release. A boolean output flow `<name>` produced under a condition: `<name>_fed_out` is true while the production condition holds and the output is available. The condition is a disjunction of conjunctions: a list of groups, each a list of attribute names of the instance, and the output is produced while every attribute of at least one group is true. `<name>_fed_available_out` is written by the modes only: a mode cuts it when it starts available, and wakes it when it starts unavailable. With `negate`, it delivers the negation of that delivery.

parameters.name: prod_cond
parameters.description: Production condition: any of these groups, each all of its attributes (for example [["power_fed_in"]]).

parameters.name: fed_available_init
parameters.description: Whether the output starts available. A dormant service output starts unavailable and a compromise mode wakes it.

parameters.name: negate
parameters.description: Whether the output delivers the negation of its delivery (production and availability), as a muscadet `negate` output does. Production and availability are unchanged.

fragments.name: bool_source_out
fragments.description: Forwards to `muscadet.bool_source_out`, which this name applies unchanged; withdrawn at the next major release. A boolean output flow `<name>` with no production condition: a constant source, or a dormant function when `prod_init` is false. Nothing in the type writes `<name>_prod_available`, so a mode may activate (or cut) it. With `negate`, it delivers the negation of that delivery.

parameters.name: prod_init
parameters.description: Whether the source produces from the start.

parameters.name: negate
parameters.description: Whether the output delivers the negation of its delivery (production and availability), as a muscadet `negate` output does. Production and availability are unchanged.

fragments.name: bool_flow_out_tempo
fragments.description: Forwards to `muscadet.bool_flow_out_tempo`, which this name applies unchanged; withdrawn at the next major release. A temporised boolean output `<name>` (muscadet `FlowOutTempo`): it feeds while the automaton `<name>_tempo` is `enabled`. The automaton enables after `enable_law` once the production condition holds and disables after `disable_law` once it fails; both waits restart when the condition changes again before they end. A lost condition keeps the output fed until the disable wait ends.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Flow name; the out port is `<name>_out`.

parameters.name: prod_cond
parameters.description: The production condition in disjunctive form: a list of groups, each a list of boolean attribute names of the instance (`<input>_fed_in`, `<output>_fed_out`) that must all hold.

parameters.name: conditioned
parameters.description: Whether `prod_cond` writes the production; false keeps `<name>_prod_available` at `prod_init` (a mode may still write it).

parameters.name: enable_law
parameters.description: Law of the wait before enabling: a fixed delay or an exponential draw; `never` builds no transition (a wait that never ends, as an exponential wait of rate zero).

parameters.name: enable_value
parameters.description: The delay (`delay`) or the rate (`exp`, positive) of the enable wait.

parameters.name: disable_law
parameters.description: Law of the wait before disabling; `never` builds no transition (a wait that never ends, as an exponential wait of rate zero).

parameters.name: disable_value
parameters.description: The delay (`delay`) or the rate (`exp`, positive) of the disable wait.

fragments.name: bool_flow_out_trigger
fragments.description: Forwards to `muscadet.bool_flow_out_trigger`, which this name applies unchanged; withdrawn at the next major release. A boolean output flow `<name>` fed while a `down`/`up` automaton `<name>_trigger` is `up`, as a muscadet `FlowOutOnTrigger`: the trigger inhibits. `up` is reached `time_up` after the trigger aggregate over the in port `<name>_trigger_in` turns false, `down` `time_down` after it turns true (delays, reset on interruption). The delivery is `up` and the production and the availability.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Flow name; the out port is `<name>_out`.

parameters.name: prod_cond
parameters.description: The production condition in disjunctive form: a list of groups, each a list of boolean attribute names of the instance (`<input>_fed_in`, `<output>_fed_out`) that must all hold.

parameters.name: conditioned
parameters.description: Whether `prod_cond` writes the production; false keeps `<name>_prod_available` at `prod_init` (a mode may still write it).

parameters.name: logic
parameters.description: Trigger aggregate over `<name>_trigger_in`: all inputs (an unconnected port inhibits nothing), any input, or at least `k` inputs.

parameters.name: time_up
parameters.description: Delay before `up` once the trigger is absent.

parameters.name: time_down
parameters.description: Delay before `down` once the trigger is present.

parameters.name: armed
parameters.description: Whether the automaton starts `up`. The declaration route starts it `up` when nothing feeds the trigger port and `time_up` is zero (the trigger is absent for ever); a system-level fact the caller states.

fragments.name: logic_gate
fragments.description: Forwards to `muscadet.logic_gate`, which this name applies unchanged; withdrawn at the next major release. A logic gate `<name>`: a boolean input combining its sources under `logic`, re-exported on the out port `<name>_out`.

parameters.name: logic
parameters.description: How the connected sources combine: all of them (and), any of them (or), or at least k of them (k). An input nothing feeds reads its default under every logic.

parameters.name: k
parameters.description: The k of a k-out-of-n input.

parameters.name: default
parameters.description: What the input reads while no connection feeds it.

fragments.name: state_out
fragments.description: Exports whether automaton `automaton` is in one of `states`, as the boolean attribute `<name>` on the out port `<name>_out`. A port carries an attribute, never a state: this is how a neighbour reads a state, with `any`, `all` or `sum` (which counts the true sources) over its in port. The attribute is written by a sensitive function, which runs inside the firing that changes the state, so a reader sees it at the same instant as a direct read.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of the exported attribute; the port is `<name>_out`.

parameters.name: automaton
parameters.description: The automaton of the instance whose state is exported.

parameters.name: states
parameters.description: The states for which the attribute is true.

parameters.name: init
parameters.description: The attribute's initial value: whether the automaton's initial state is one of `states`.

fragments.name: bool_not
fragments.description: The negation of a boolean attribute `<of>` of the instance, as the attribute `<of>_not`: how a production condition, which only reads attributes, reads `<of>` being false. It is written by a sensitive function, so it changes inside the firing that changes `<of>`.

parameters.name: of
parameters.description: The boolean attribute of the instance to negate.

parameters.name: init
parameters.description: Initial value of `<of>_not`; the initial fixpoint sets it from `<of>` either way.

fragments.name: continuous_flow_out
fragments.description: Forwards to `muscadet.continuous_flow_out`, which this name applies unchanged; withdrawn at the next major release. A continuous output flow `<name>` of a conservative network: the out port `<name>_out` and the totals `<name>_demand_out` (what its consumers ask) and `<name>_fed_out` (what they receive). Each connection's claim is its consumer's demand truncated at the quantity distributed, and a distribution operator splits that quantity over the claims. What a consumer receives is its allocation scaled by the share it accepts. The capability `<name>_capability_out` is declared here and written by the fragment that makes the flow (`continuous_source`, `volume_outlet`, `rule_produces`, `tap`).

parameters.name: available
parameters.description: What the operator distributes: the capability (a source, a volume), what a rule set actually produced (`<name>_produced_out`), a mixed volume's pooled draw (`<name>_pooled_out`, `volume_pooled_flow`), or that draw for mixture groups (`mixture`: `volume_pooled_flow` with `drawn`), which hands each connection its composed request scaled to what the volume delivers and publishes the composition `<name>_composition_out` on the `composition` channel.

parameters.name: shares
parameters.description: For `shares`: one `{"to": {"component", "port"}, "value"}` per consumer, summing to 1.

parameters.name: held
parameters.description: Whether the flow leaves a volume: while that volume has run out, it passes on what arrives and a releasing consumer accepts it first.

parameters.name: empty_automaton
parameters.description: With `held`: the automaton whose `empty` state says the volume has run out of the flow.

fragments.name: continuous_flow_in
fragments.description: Forwards to `muscadet.continuous_flow_in`, which this name applies unchanged; withdrawn at the next major release. A continuous input flow `<name>` of a conservative network: the in port `<name>_in`, the capability `<name>_capability_in` its suppliers offer, and `<name>_fed_in`, what it receives. It publishes its demand `<name>_demand_in` (written by the fragment that consumes the flow) and the shares it accepts on every connection feeding it; the shares stay 1 unless `surplus_release` applies. An input no connection feeds receives zero.

fragments.name: surplus_release
fragments.description: Forwards to `muscadet.surplus_release`, which this name applies unchanged; withdrawn at the next major release. Makes the input `<name>` (a `continuous_flow_in`) hand back what it does not need when two suppliers or more offer more than its demand, pro rata of what each offered. A supplier whose volume has run out (`held` on its `continuous_flow_out`) passes on what arrives and is accepted first; the others share what is left. With a single supplier both shares stay 1. Apply it to an input a rule set consumes and no volume holds.

fragments.name: continuous_source
fragments.description: Forwards to `muscadet.continuous_source`, which this name applies unchanged; withdrawn at the next major release. Writes the capability of the output `<name>` (a `continuous_flow_out`) of a source: its rate, times the time profile `<name>_out_profile` when `profiled`.

fragments.name: continuous_sink
fragments.description: Forwards to `muscadet.continuous_sink`, which this name applies unchanged; withdrawn at the next major release. Writes the demand of the input `<name>` (a `continuous_flow_in`) of a consumer: its rate, times the time profile `<name>_in_profile` when `profiled`.

fragments.name: time_profile
fragments.description: A sinusoidal time profile written into the attribute `<target>`: max(value_min, amplitude sin(2 pi (t - phase_shift) / period) + offset).

parameters.name: initial
parameters.description: Initial value of the attribute (the profile at t = 0).

fragments.name: rate_publisher
fragments.description: Forwards to `muscadet.rate_publisher`, which this name applies unchanged; withdrawn at the next major release. Publishes a flow's rate on the out port `<name>_rate_out` (attribute `<name>_rate`): the capability of an output, or what a flow delivers: what an input receives (`side: in`) or what an output delivers (`side: out`).

parameters.name: side
parameters.description: For `of: delivered`, whether `<name>` is an input or an output.

fragments.name: pass_through
fragments.description: Forwards to `muscadet.pass_through`, which this name applies unchanged; withdrawn at the next major release. The flow `<name>` crosses the component unchanged, from the input `<name>` (a `continuous_flow_in`) to the output `<name>` (a `continuous_flow_out` with `available: produced`), with no volume, rule set or conduit on it: the input asks what the output is asked (zero when nothing reads the output), the output can deliver what could arrive and hands on what did arrive (`<name>_produced_out`), both scaled by `<name>_out_rate` and never negative.

fragments.name: volume_flow
fragments.description: Forwards to `muscadet.volume_flow`, which this name applies unchanged; withdrawn at the next major release. One flow `<flow>` held in the volume `<volume>`: its content (an ODE: what arrives less what leaves), its fill fraction, and the demand of the input `<flow>` (a `continuous_flow_in`), which asks its nominal demand plus the fill rate while the volume is not full (with `fill_unbounded`, whatever its suppliers can deliver) and no more than leaves once it is. The volume's bounds come from `volume_total`; an outlet adds `volume_outlet`. With side `in`, the volume sits upstream of a rule set: the rule draws from it (`rule_consumes` with `from_volume`, which writes `<flow>_need_in` and `<flow>_drawn_in`), whatever it needs while the flow is stocked and what arrives once it has run out (`<flow>_serve_capability_in`, `<flow>_serve_fed_in`); the input asks the rule's need plus the fill while the volume is not full, and the need alone once it is.

parameters.name: fill_rate
parameters.description: Rate the volume fills at on top of the demand.

parameters.name: fill_unbounded
parameters.description: Whether the volume claims without bound while it is not full (whatever its suppliers can deliver); `fill_rate` is then ignored.

parameters.name: outlet
parameters.description: Whether the flow also leaves the volume (a `volume_outlet`).

parameters.name: side
parameters.description: Where the volume sits: `out`, between the input and an output of the same flow; `in`, upstream of a rule set that draws the flow from it (`rule_consumes` with `from_volume`).

parameters.name: empty_automaton
parameters.description: With side `in`: the automaton whose `empty` state says the flow has run out (`<volume>_bounds` for a single-flow volume, `<volume>_stock_<flow>` for a multi-flow one).

fragments.name: volume_outlet
fragments.description: Forwards to `muscadet.volume_outlet`, which this name applies unchanged; withdrawn at the next major release. Writes the capability of the output `<flow>` (a `continuous_flow_out`) leaving the volume `<volume>`: its rate, bounded by what the volume serves, and by what arrives while the automaton `<empty_automaton>` is `empty`.

parameters.name: empty_automaton
parameters.description: Automaton whose `empty` state says the flow has run out.

fragments.name: volume_stock
fragments.description: Forwards to `muscadet.volume_stock`, which this name applies unchanged; withdrawn at the next major release. An automaton `<volume>_stock_<flow>` (`empty`, `stocked`) following whether the volume `<volume>` holds any of the flow `<flow>`: what a multi-flow volume tests per flow.

fragments.name: volume_total
fragments.description: Forwards to `muscadet.volume_total`, which this name applies unchanged; withdrawn at the next major release. The volume `<volume>` holding the flows `<flows>` (each a `volume_flow`): its total content and fill, the bounds automaton `<volume>_bounds` (`empty`, `partial`, `full`) on the total, and the share of each flow listed in `ratio_flows`.

parameters.name: ratio_flows
parameters.description: Flows whose share of the content is published as `<volume>_ratio_<flow>`.

fragments.name: rule_set
fragments.description: Forwards to `muscadet.rule_set`, which this name applies unchanged; withdrawn at the next major release. A rule set `<name>` with one producing rule `<active>` and one idle rule `<idle>`: the automaton `<name>_mode` runs `<active>` while every boolean input in `conditions` is fed (and, with a `band` threshold, while the capability of `<threshold_flow>` has reached `activate` and not fallen below `release`). The rule's scale is the largest fraction of its nominal rates the inputs' capabilities allow (`<name>_capability_scale`), bounded by what the outputs are asked (`<name>_scale`) and by what actually arrives (`<name>_draw_scale`). With `always_on`, the set has its producing rule only, with no condition and no automaton, as a rule declared without a condition. Each consumed flow is a `rule_consumes`, each produced one a `rule_produces`. The outputs in `cascaded` are produced by another rule set too and served in declaration order: this set is bounded by what those declared before it leave (`<name>_<flow>_left`, a `rule_cascade`) instead of by the whole demand.

parameters.name: idle
parameters.description: Name of the idle rule (unused with `always_on`, where it names no state).

parameters.name: cascaded
parameters.description: Produced flows shared with rule sets declared before this one (`rule_produces` with `shared`), bounded by `<name>_<flow>_left` rather than by the output's demand. They are not listed in `produces`.

parameters.name: from_volume
parameters.description: Flows the producing rule consumes from a volume upstream of it (`volume_flow` with side `in`), listed here instead of in `consumes`: the rule reads what the volume serves.

parameters.name: capped
parameters.description: Produced flows with a maximum rate (`rule_produces` with `capped`).

parameters.name: conditions
parameters.description: Boolean inputs (`bool_flow_in`) that must all be fed.

parameters.name: threshold
parameters.description: An optional band on the capability of `threshold_flow`.

parameters.name: threshold_flow
parameters.description: With `band`: the input whose capability is compared.

parameters.name: activate
parameters.description: With `band`: the capability at which the rule starts (>=).

parameters.name: release
parameters.description: With `band`: the capability under which it stops (<).

parameters.name: always_on
parameters.description: Whether the rule set has one rule and no condition: no `<rule_set>_mode` automaton, the producing rule always applies.

fragments.name: rule_consumes
fragments.description: Forwards to `muscadet.rule_consumes`, which this name applies unchanged; withdrawn at the next major release. The producing rule `<active>` of the rule set `<rule_set>` consumes the input `<flow>` (a `continuous_flow_in`) at `rate` per unit of scale: it writes the input's demand, or, with `from_volume`, the need and the draw a volume upstream of it serves.

parameters.name: always_on
parameters.description: Whether the rule set has one rule and no condition: no `<rule_set>_mode` automaton, the producing rule always applies.

parameters.name: from_volume
parameters.description: Whether the rule draws the flow from a volume upstream of it (`volume_flow` with side `in`): the rule's need is written to `<flow>_need_in` and what it draws to `<flow>_drawn_in`, and the volume writes the input's demand.

fragments.name: rule_produces
fragments.description: Forwards to `muscadet.rule_produces`, which this name applies unchanged; withdrawn at the next major release. The producing rule `<active>` of the rule set `<rule_set>` produces the output `<flow>` (a `continuous_flow_out` with `available: produced`) at `rate` per unit of scale: its capability at the capability scale and `<flow>_produced_out` at the draw scale, bounded by `max_rate` when `capped`. With `tapped`, they are written before a `tap` takes its leaks (`<flow>_pre_tap_capability_out`, `<flow>_pre_tap_produced_out`). With `shared`, another rule set produces the flow too: the set writes its contributions `<rule_set>_<flow>_capability`, `<rule_set>_<flow>_production` and `<rule_set>_<flow>_served` (what it is expected to make, at its scale), which a `shared_output` sums onto the output and a `rule_cascade` subtracts from the demand left to the sets declared after it; `capped` and `tapped` do not apply.

parameters.name: capped
parameters.description: Whether the output has a maximum rate.

parameters.name: tapped
parameters.description: Whether a `tap` takes leaks from the output.

parameters.name: always_on
parameters.description: Whether the rule set has one rule and no condition: no `<rule_set>_mode` automaton, the producing rule always applies.

parameters.name: shared
parameters.description: Whether another rule set produces the flow too (`shared_output`).

fragments.name: shared_output
fragments.description: Forwards to `muscadet.shared_output`, which this name applies unchanged; withdrawn at the next major release. The output `<flow>` (a `continuous_flow_out` with `available: produced`) of two rule sets or more (each a `rule_produces` with `shared`): its capability and `<flow>_produced_out` are the sums of their contributions, scaled by the output's rate.

parameters.name: producers
parameters.description: The rule sets producing the flow, in declaration order.

fragments.name: rule_cascade
fragments.description: Forwards to `muscadet.rule_cascade`, which this name applies unchanged; withdrawn at the next major release. The demand of the output `<flow>` left to the rule set `<rule_set>` by the sets producing it declared before it (`before`): `<rule_set>_<flow>_left`, the output's demand less what those sets are expected to make (their `<set>_<flow>_served`), never below zero. The rule set lists the flow in `cascaded`.

parameters.name: rule_set
parameters.description: Rule set the demand is left to.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: The rule sets producing the flow declared before `rule_set`, in declaration order.

fragments.name: tap
fragments.description: Forwards to `muscadet.tap`, which this name applies unchanged; withdrawn at the next major release. Leaks taken from the output `<flow>` (a `rule_produces` with `tapped`) into the outputs `<outlets>` (each a `continuous_flow_out` with `available: produced`): outlet `o` takes the fraction `<o>_pct` (0 by default, the attribute a failure mode targets) and the output keeps `<flow>_tap_rate`, one less their sum.

fragments.name: aggregate_measure
fragments.description: A measured quantity `<name>`: what is connected to the in port `<name>_in`, reduced by `agg` (the sum, the mean or the median of the connected values; the median of an even count is the mean of the two central ones). `initial` is its value before the first evaluation; a port nothing feeds reads zero from then on.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Measure name (an attribute and its in port).

parameters.name: agg
parameters.description: How the connected values reduce to one.

fragments.name: threshold_compare
fragments.description: A boolean output `<name>` (out port `<name>_out`), true while the attribute `<input>` compares to `<name>_threshold` under `operator`, the crossing located exactly; `<name>_signal_available` false forces it false.

parameters.name: operator
parameters.description: Comparison that makes the output true.

fragments.name: threshold_band
fragments.description: A boolean output `<name>` (out port `<name>_out`) with a hysteresis band on the attribute `<input>`: `below` turns it true when the input falls to `activate` and false when it rises above `release`; `above` the other way round. `<name>_signal_available` false forces it false.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: Side of the band that activates.

fragments.name: republish
fragments.description: A value output `<name>` publishing the attribute `<input>` times `<name>_level_gain` on the out port `<name>_level_out` (attribute `<name>_level`), as an instrument does. With `<name>_forced` true it publishes `<name>_forced_value` instead, times the same gain. A failure mode may set any of the three.

parameters.name: initial
parameters.description: Published value before the first evaluation.
